primary_source.finding: Format 3.1.0 has typed Name, Level and Expr primitive references. Inductive records group types, constructors and recursors, including redundant but checker-relevant metadata; quot is a four-declaration package. Closure must preserve these records and referenced environment owners.

retained_payloads.reason: The three smallest available retained exports cover Init, Std and Cedar namespaces while keeping full-byte source verification and prefix indexing feasible on the actual host.

reuse.decision: Reuse its primitive typed-reference and fail-closed validation patterns. Its declaration set excludes grouped inductive and quot records, so it cannot alone audit this slice contract.
Reuse supervised positive-RSS start gate, per-process memory/timeout controls, raw-stream custody and cleanup accounting.
Reuse the exact supported official Lean 4.33.0 and Nanoda 6ae1f0c observer profiles, then verify current source/binary/configuration identities before this launch.

build_decision: Implement only the missing grouped declaration, quotient and environment-closure slicer with an independent negative-capable auditor. Bind a deterministic selection and exact source/observer controls before construction and observation.
